1.web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
1.asv: Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.

2.web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
2.asv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.

3.web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
3.asv: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.

4.web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
4.asv: Thou hast commandedus thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.

5.web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
5.asv: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!

6.web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
6.asv: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.

7.web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
7.asv: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.

8.web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
8.asv: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly. ב BETH.

9.web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
9.asv: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to thy word.

10.web: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
10.asv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.

11.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
11.asv: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.

12.web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
12.asv: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.

13.web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
13.asv: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.

14.web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
14.asv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.

15.web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
15.asv: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.

16.web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
16.asv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. ג GIMEL.

17.web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
17.asv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.

18.web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
18.asv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.

19.web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
19.asv: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.

20.web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
20.asv: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.

21.web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
21.asv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.

22.web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
22.asv: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.

23.web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
23.asv: Princes also sat and talked against me; But thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.

24.web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
24.asv: Thy testimonies also are my delight Andmy counsellors. ד DALETH.

25.web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
25.asv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.

26.web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
26.asv: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.

27.web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
27.asv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.

28.web: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
28.asv: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

29.web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
29.asv: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.

30.web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
30.asv: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set before me.

31.web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
31.asv: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.

32.web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
32.asv: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart. ה HE.

33.web: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
33.asv: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.

34.web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
34.asv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

35.web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
35.asv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.

36.web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
36.asv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.

37.web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
37.asv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.

38.web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
38.asv: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Whichis in order unto the fear of thee.

39.web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
39.asv: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.

40.web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
40.asv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness. ו VAV.

41.web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
41.asv: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.

42.web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
42.asv: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.

43.web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
43.asv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.

44.web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
44.asv: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.

45.web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
45.asv: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.

46.web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
46.asv: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.

47.web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
47.asv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.

48.web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
48.asv: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes. ז ZAYIN.

49.web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
49.asv: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.

50.web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
50.asv: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.

51.web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
51.asv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: Yethave I not swerved from thy law.

52.web: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
52.asv: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.

53.web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
53.asv: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

54.web: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.
54.asv: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.

55.web: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
55.asv: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.

56.web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
56.asv: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts. ח HHETH.

57.web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
57.asv: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.

58.web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
58.asv: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.

59.web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
59.asv: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

60.web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
60.asv: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.

61.web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
61.asv: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; ButI have not forgotten thy law.

62.web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
62.asv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.

63.web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
63.asv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.

64.web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
64.asv: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes. ט TETH.

65.web: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
65.asv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

66.web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
66.asv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.

67.web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
67.asv: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.

68.web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
68.asv: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.

69.web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
69.asv: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.

70.web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
70.asv: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.

71.web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
71.asv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.

72.web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
72.asv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver. י YODH.

73.web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
73.asv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

74.web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
74.asv: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.

75.web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
75.asv: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

76.web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
76.asv: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.

77.web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
77.asv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.

78.web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
78.asv: Let the proud be put to shame; for they have overthrown me wrongfully: ButI will meditate on thy precepts.

79.web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
79.asv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.

80.web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
80.asv: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame. כ KAPH.

81.web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
81.asv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation; ButI hope in thy word.

82.web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
82.asv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?

83.web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
83.asv: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.

84.web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
84.asv: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

85.web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
85.asv: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.

86.web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
86.asv: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

87.web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
87.asv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.

88.web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
88.asv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth. ל LAMEDH.

89.web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
89.asv: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.

90.web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
90.asv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

91.web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
91.asv: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.

92.web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
92.asv: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

93.web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
93.asv: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.

94.web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
94.asv: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.

95.web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
95.asv: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; But I will consider thy testimonies.

96.web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
96.asv: I have seen an end of all perfection; But thy commandment is exceeding broad. מ MEM.

97.web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
97.asv: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

98.web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
98.asv: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.

99.web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
99.asv: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.

100.web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
100.asv: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.

101.web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
101.asv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.

102.web: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
102.asv: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.

103.web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
103.asv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

104.web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
104.asv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN.

105.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
105.asv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.

106.web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
106.asv: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.

107.web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
107.asv: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

108.web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
108.asv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.

109.web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
109.asv: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.

110.web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
110.asv: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.

111.web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
111.asv: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.

112.web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
112.asv: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end. ס SAMEKH.

113.web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
113.asv: I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.

114.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
114.asv: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

115.web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
115.asv: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.

116.web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
116.asv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.

117.web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
117.asv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.

118.web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
118.asv: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.

119.web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
119.asv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.

120.web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
120.asv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments. ע AYIN.

121.web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
121.asv: I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.

122.web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
122.asv: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.

123.web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
123.asv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.

124.web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
124.asv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.

125.web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
125.asv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.

126.web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
126.asv: It is time for Jehovah to work; Forthey have made void thy law.

127.web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
127.asv: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

128.web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
128.asv: Therefore I esteem allthyprecepts concerning allthingsto be right; AndI hate every false way. פ PE.

129.web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
129.asv: Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.

130.web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
130.asv: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.

131.web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
131.asv: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.

132.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
132.asv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

133.web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
133.asv: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

134.web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
134.asv: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.

135.web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
135.asv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.

136.web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
136.asv: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law. צ TSADHE.

137.web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
137.asv: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.

138.web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
138.asv: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.

139.web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
139.asv: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.

140.web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
140.asv: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.

141.web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
141.asv: I am small and despised; Yet do I not forget thy precepts.

142.web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
142.asv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.

143.web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
143.asv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; Yet thy commandments are my delight.

144.web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
144.asv: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live. ק QOPH.

145.web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
145.asv: I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.

146.web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
146.asv: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.

147.web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
147.asv: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.

148.web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
148.asv: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.

149.web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
149.asv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.

150.web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
150.asv: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.

151.web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
151.asv: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.

152.web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
152.asv: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever. ר RESH.

153.web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
153.asv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.

154.web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
154.asv: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.

155.web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
155.asv: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.

156.web: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
156.asv: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.

157.web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
157.asv: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yethave I not swerved from thy testimonies.

158.web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
158.asv: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.

159.web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
159.asv: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.

160.web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
160.asv: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances endureth for ever. ש SHIN.

161.web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
161.asv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.

162.web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
162.asv: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.

163.web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
163.asv: I hate and abhor falsehood; But thy law do I love.

164.web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
164.asv: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.

165.web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
165.asv: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.

166.web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
166.asv: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.

167.web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
167.asv: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

168.web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
168.asv: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee. ת TAV.

169.web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
169.asv: Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.

170.web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
170.asv: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.

171.web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
171.asv: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.

172.web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
172.asv: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.

173.web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
173.asv: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.

174.web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
174.asv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.

175.web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
175.asv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.

176.web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
176.asv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.
